summary: Well-structured solution implementing three retention policies correctly. Issues: (1) NOW env var lacks validation (main.ts)—invalid ISO string creates Invalid Date silently, (2) JSDoc outdated (retention.ts line 23 claims only maxAgeDays implemented, but code implements all three). Workflow uses pinned actions, least-privilege permissions, proper structure. Test harness comprehensive with exact output assertions. Minor gaps prevent 5/5.
